DATA 10 — TOPIC SYNTHESIS AND PRACTICE
====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what data 10 — topic synthesis and practice means in plain words.
• Give one Kenyan example linked to Data 10.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----
Focus on data 10. On “Data 10 — Topic Synthesis and Practice”, learners often mix up data 10 with a nearby idea. Keep this accurate line instead: Collect data of at most 10 items within the school environment,. Supporting detail: Record data in the table,.

MAIN NOTES
----
• Data 10 — Topic Synthesis and Practice belongs to number and measurement work in mathematics.
• Always show the method: write what you know → choose an operation or formula → substitute → compute → check.
• Example numbers for this page: 7 and 7 (sum 14, product 49).
• Place value reminder: read each digit’s place carefully in numbers like 444.
• Units matter: write cm, m, Ksh, or items so the answer matches the question.

WORKED EXAMPLE
----
Worked example on Data 10:
A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 20 each. Find the total.

Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Total = number × amount each
2. Substitute values: Total = 14 × 20
3. Total = 280
Final Answer: Ksh 280
Mark reminder: method mark for multiplication; accuracy mark for answer

Wrong path to avoid: adding 14 + 20 = 34 when equal groups need multiplication.

IN EVERYDAY LIFE
----
Practise Data 10: focus on data 10 — topic synthesis and practice. Ask which key word or formula fits, then check your answer against the worked example and diagram on this page. Careful checking comes first.

SUMMARY
----
• Data 10 — Topic Synthesis and Practice belongs to number and measurement work in mathematics.
• Always show the method: write what you know → choose an operation or formula → substitute → compute → check.
• Example numbers for this page: 7 and 7 (sum 14, product 49).
• Place value reminder: read each digit’s place carefully in numbers like 444.

REVISION QUESTIONS
----
1. Define data 10 — topic synthesis and practice in your own words and give one clear example from Data 10.
2. Show full working (or labeled steps) for a problem on this page about Data 10.
3. A learner makes a mistake about data 10 — topic synthesis and practice. State the wrong idea, correct it, and justify your correction.

ANSWERS
----
1. Data 10 — Topic Synthesis and Practice belongs to number and measurement work in mathematics. Example: connect it to a concrete case from Data 10.
2. Award marks for: correct formula/relationship, substitution, steps, and final answer with units (or labeled science steps).
3. Wrong idea: mixing data 10 — topic synthesis and practice with a neighbouring concept or skipping the method. Correct idea: Collect data of at most 10 items within the school environment,. Justification: follow the worked example (and diagram if shown) on this page.
